title: add_env_var
description: Adds or updates an environment variable in a configuration file such as a .env file, a Kubernetes ConfigMap, or a CI/CD environment definition.

var_name.description: The name of the environment variable to add or update (e.g. 'DATABASE_URL', 'LOG_LEVEL', 'FEATURE_X_ENABLED'). Should follow uppercase snake_case convention.

value.description: The value to assign to the environment variable.

target_file.description: Optional path to the file where the environment variable should be written (e.g. '.env', '.env.production', 'k8s/configmap.yaml'). Defaults to '.env' in the repository root if omitted.
